query: adversarial attacks, data augmentation, textattack, nlp models
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    (p.title ILIKE '%adversarial attack%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%adversarial attack%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%adversarial example%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%adversarial example%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%adversarial robustness%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%adversarial robustness%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%data augmentation%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%data augmentation%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%nlp%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%nlp%' OR p.title ILIKE '%natural language%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%natural language%')
  )
  OR (p.title ILIKE '%textattack%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%textattack%')
ORDER BY
  p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST,
  p.year DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,

    (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%dynamic programming%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%dynamic programming%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END)
  ) AS relevance_score
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  p.abstract IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    p.title ILIKE '%graph kernel%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%graph kernels%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%graph kernel%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%graph kernels%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%handwritten digit%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%handwritten digit%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%dynamic programming%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%dynamic programming%'
  )
ORDER BY relevance_score DESC, p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST, p.year DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,

   (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%discriminative string transduction%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
   (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%morphological analysis%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
   (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%morphological analysis%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
   (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%finite state analyzer%' OR p.title ILIKE '%finite-state analyzer%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
   (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%finite state analyzer%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%finite-state analyzer%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
   (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%finite state transducer%' OR p.title ILIKE '%finite-state transducer%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
   (CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%finite state transducer%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%finite-state transducer%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

query: joint learning topics, word sense disambiguation
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count,
  ts_rank_cd(
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '')), 'A') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.abstract, '')), 'B'),
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'joint learning') ||
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'word sense disambiguation') ||
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'WSD')
  ) AS relevance
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, '')) @@
    (plainto_tsquery('english', 'joint learning') ||
     plainto_tsquery('english', 'word sense disambiguation') ||
     plainto_tsquery('english', 'WSD'))
ORDER BY relevance DESC
LIMIT 100
